Name: Swimsuits at the Luau
Author: scorcher9009
Description:
I always thought it was weird that the Luau had everyone in their normal, everyday clothes. So I decided to fix that. This mod makes it so the characters wear their swimsuits seen on Ginger Island.



Some big things to note though:
[list]
[*]I was too lazy to recreate Robin's dancing sprites, so right now she's just watching Demetrius dance awkwardly.
[*]This most likely will not be fully compatible with Seasonal Outfits.
[*]This mod only affects the NPCs who actually have swimsuit sprites, so no Marlon, no Wizard, etc.
[/list]
This is the first mod I've ever uploaded, so that's something. All the sprites in this mod are either straight up vanilla assets or slightly modified vanilla assets.

Credit to PodRED on Discord for testing the mod and for the screenshots.
